contract.options: one CONTINUE plus all retained DIVIDE(daughter_a,daughter_b) pairs per source
contract.loss: source-local grouped softmax; multiple correct pairs use positive-set logsumexp
contract.division_time_label: exact GT parent frame only; nearby matched rows are not positives

contract.threshold_policy: frozen from grouped train-video OOF before held-20
